site.name: notion
site.summary: notion-clone Clone of the Notion marketing funnel: home + product sub-pages + templates + pricing. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: top nav (Product / Download / Solutions / Resources / Pricing / Request demo / Log in / Get Notion free), hero section (product positioning + CTA + main screenshot), modular product intros (Docs / Wikis / Projects / AI), customer logo wall, customer stories, multi-column footer | | `projects.html` | Project management sub-page: feature highlights, view-switching screenshots (Board / Timeline / Calendar), case studies, CTA | | `wikis.html` | Wiki sub-page: knowledge-base examples, permissions / search / template features, CTA |

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Notion marketing site, focusing on the primary landing flow (home + key product pages) and adjacent states, ensuring coverage of all known pages, visible controls, and mobile responsiveness.
run_plan.summary: The run will start with the home page (index.html), validate top navigation and primary CTAs, then explore each product sub-page (Projects, Wikis, Templates, Pricing) to check interactables, headings, and layout warnings. Mobile checks will repeat critical interactions. Phases will cover home, product pages, templates, pricing, and mobile validation.
assumptions: All HTML pages load without errors (per prescan)
Interactables are clickable and functional as per their tags
Layout warnings (small tap targets) are consistent across viewports
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (per layout warnings) on navigation links and CTAs
Consistency of CTA functionality (e.g., 'Get Notion free', 'Request a demo') across pages

phases.title: Home Page Exploration
phases.objective: Validate home page navigation, CTAs, and content structure
key_checks: Click top navigation links (Projects, Wikis, Templates, Pricing) to ensure they navigate to correct pages
Interact with primary CTAs ('Get Notion free', 'Request a demo') to check functionality (even if they are JavaScript links)
Verify headings and content sections match prescan summary
Check layout warnings for small tap targets on home page interactables
exit_criteria: All top navigation links tested, primary CTAs interacted with, home page content validated

phases.title: Product Sub-Pages (Projects, Wikis)
phases.objective: Explore Projects and Wikis pages, validate content and interactables
key_checks: For each page, verify headings and content sections match prescan (e.g., Projects' 'Infinitely configurable...' section, Wikis' 'Find, edit, browse...' section)
Interact with top interactables (navigation links, CTAs) on each page
Check layout warnings for small tap targets on these pages
Validate cross-links (e.g., 'Knowledge Base' on Projects linking to Wikis)
exit_criteria: Projects and Wikis pages fully explored, interactables tested, content validated

phases.title: Templates and Pricing Pages
phases.objective: Explore Templates (Projects) and Pricing pages, validate content and interactables
key_checks: For Templates page, verify template categories (Roadmaps, Issue Tracking, etc.) and interactive elements (FAQ buttons, CTAs)
For Pricing page, verify plan sections (Free, Plus, Business) and interactive elements (plan buttons, FAQ buttons)
Interact with top interactables on each page (navigation, CTAs, FAQ buttons)
Check layout warnings for small tap targets on these pages
exit_criteria: Templates and Pricing pages fully explored, interactables tested, content validated

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks in mobile viewport to validate responsiveness
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and test top navigation (tap targets) for usability
Interact with primary CTAs ('Get Notion free', 'Request a demo') in mobile view
Verify key content sections (e.g., home page hero, pricing plans) are legible and interactable in mobile
Check layout warnings (small tap targets) in mobile view
exit_criteria: Critical pages tested in mobile view, key interactables validated, responsiveness checked

phases.title: Final Coverage and Edge Cases
phases.objective: Ensure all pages are visited, all visible controls exercised, and edge cases checked
key_checks: Visit any missed pages (e.g., templates-projects.html if not fully explored)
Exercise remaining visible controls (e.g., FAQ buttons, secondary links)
Verify console and network errors remain empty across all pages
Confirm all layout warnings (small tap targets) are documented
exit_criteria: All known pages visited, most visible controls exercised, errors checked, warnings documented

coverage_targets.pages: visit all 5 known HTML pages (index, projects, wikis, templates-projects, pricing)
coverage_targets.features: exercise at least 80% of visible controls (links, buttons, FAQ toggles) across all pages
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical interactions (navigation, CTAs) on at least 3 key pages (home, projects, pricing) in mobile viewport

notes: Focus on interactable elements with 'clickable' kind from prescan. Prioritize navigation and CTAs first, then secondary controls like FAQ buttons.

observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free PROJECTS Manage projects from beginning to end With Notion's connected workspace, get your projects to the finish line faster and with less context switching. Get Notion free Trusted by teams of 100 to 1000+ OpenAI Volvo Ramp Cursor Figma Nvidia Infinitely configurable, so you can work the way you want Capture every detail in a database Track all your important information in one place, so nothing slips through the cracks. Combine multiple data sources and prevent information silos. View projects as a timeline for a bird's eye view See the bigger picture of how projects fit together, so you can resolve dependencies and hit your deadlines. Visualize progress with charts Create a dashboard with charts from as many sources as you want. Choose the exact info you want to track Create your own priority labels, status tags, and more, so every team can craft the perfect workflow. Automate your team workflows Spend less time on manual tasks with automations that streamline task flows, bug reports, database entries, doc outlines and more. Filter and sort info to see what you need Show only tasks assigned to you, or items marked as urgent. Break down any complex project in the way that's most helpful to you. Capture requests with forms Collect information from your team. Then kick off tasks and workflows. Control who can see and edit Set granular permissions in your databases without manual sharing. Page-level access rules automatically grant permissions based on assignee or owner. Catch all the details, big and small Tasks and sub-tasks Break projects into manageable pieces to get the work done. Status, assignee, due date So everyone knows what to do and when to do it. Database views Visualize the work in distinct formats, from calendars to boards. Dependencies See when one task is blocking another and avoid bottlenecks. My tasks Manage every task assigned to you in one place. Progress bar See how your project is tracking toward its launch. Focus on what's important. Leave the rest to AI. Automate tedious, time-consuming tasks Customizable AI Autofill adds user stories, key results, updates, and more for every project deliverable. Ship faster with automated sprints Move projects forward with automated sprints Engineering and product teams have everything they need with out-of-the-box workflows to groom your backlog, organize sprints, and track bugs. Your PRDs alongside your sprint plans Every task has a page that contains all the project info to not just plan the thing, but build the thing. Connections with GitHub, Slack, & more bring all your work together 🎨 Figma Always share the most updated designs with your team. 💬 Slack Paste a link to see the full message without switching tools. 🐙 GitHub Bring pull requests, issues, and repos directly into Notion. 📈 Amplitude Track release metrics, experiment results, and more. 🔷 Jira See bug updates, or convert an entire project into a database. observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle.
